title: Cucumbers and summer squash
summary: Provide space, pollination access, steady water and frequent harvest.
steps: Direct-sow or transplant only after soil and weather are suitably warm.
Give vines space or a strong trellis and avoid crushing the main stem.
Water near roots and keep leaves as dry as practical to reduce disease pressure.
Protect flowering access for pollinators and avoid unnecessary insecticide use during bloom.
Harvest frequently at useful size; oversized fruit slows continued production and may be poor quality.
